_note: STUB for plug brands other than Tuya. Optional second plug file; copy to data/extra_plugs.json. Same schema as plug_array.json; an entry with no driver is the 'tbd' placeholder, which reports 'not selected' and never alarms. Names must not repeat plug_array.json. A driver name that does not exist is reported as an error.
_for_future_agents: TERMINOLOGY: in this project 'ecosystem' means a real-world LOCATION whose climate, light and moon data are catalogued (see tank_arcs.py and arc_catalog.json), NOT a plug brand. This file was first named ecosystem_array by mistake and renamed. To support a new plug brand: write a Plug subclass in tank_plugs.py with @register('name') (status() read-only and never raises; set_on() raises PlugError; supports_revert only if the device has a plug-side timer), mock its transport in a test (see tests/test_tank_array.py and tests/test_tank_health.py), then set 'driver' here. Details: pi-contingency-plan.md section 3.6.
